name: @hermes/phase102-media-hub-builder
description: Local, auditable Figma development plugin that generates the Phase 102 "Hermes Media & Video Hub" design (Foundations / Components / Screens) natively in Figma. No network, no telemetry, deterministic and idempotent, Starter-plan safe.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test

//: This package intentionally declares NO dependencies. Its scripts resolve tsc and vitest from the repository root node_modules (npx/direct node resolution walks up). It must not create its own lockfile and must not change the repository package manager.
